reason: The README clearly describes a Playwright-powered browser tool family for navigating real web pages, performing UI actions, extracting page content, evaluating page JavaScript, and capturing screenshots.

summaries.zh: 通过 Playwright 驱动浏览器，帮助智能体导航网页、填写表单、执行页面交互、提取内容并截图。
summaries.en: A Playwright-powered browser automation plugin that lets agents navigate web pages, interact with forms and controls, extract content, run page scripts, and capture screenshots.

capabilities: Launches and controls a Chromium-based browser
Navigates web pages and interacts with page elements
Fills forms, clicks controls, selects options, and types text
Reads visible text and page HTML
Evaluates JavaScript in the page context
